slot.subtopic: Image of a point in a line
slot.brief: Find the image of a point in a given line and construct the equation of the line joining the point to its image.

stem: The image of $P(2,-1)$ in the line $3x+4y+23=0$ and the equation of the line joining $P$ to its image are, respectively,

verdicts.working: For P(2,-1), the line expression is 25 and the normal has squared length 25. Reflection gives P'=P-2(3,4)=(-4,-9). The line through P and P' is 4x-3y-11=0.

working:
$f=3(2)+4(-1)+23=25$, $3^2+4^2=25$.
$P'=P-\dfrac{2f}{25}(3,4)=(-4,-9)$.
The joining line is perpendicular to the mirror line, so its normal is $(4,-3)$.
$4(x-2)-3(y+1)=0\Rightarrow 4x-3y-11=0$.

Independent check: For P(2,-1), the line expression is 25 and the normal has squared length 25. Reflection gives P'=P-2(3,4)=(-4,-9). The line through P and P' is 4x-3y-11=0.
solution:
For reflection across $ax+by+c=0$, $P'=P-\dfrac{2f}{a^2+b^2}(a,b)$, where $f=3(2)+4(-1)+23=25$.
$$P'=(2,-1)-2(3,4)=(-4,-9).$$
The joining line is perpendicular to the mirror line, so it has normal $(4,-3)$ and passes through $(2,-1)$: $4(x-2)-3(y+1)=0$, or $4x-3y-11=0$.
